trait.name: Divine Spellcasting
entries: Eva is a 9th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following cleric spells prepared:
• Cantrips (at will): {@spell thaumaturgy}, {@spell guidance}, {@spell sacred flame}, {@spell spare the dying}
• 1st level (4 slots): {@spell bless}, {@spell cure wounds}, {@spell command}
• 2nd level (3 slots): {@spell hold person}, {@spell spiritual weapon}
• 3rd level (3 slots): {@spell bestow curse}, {@spell dispel magic}, {@spell spirit guardians}
• 4th level (3 slots): {@spell banishment}, {@spell guardian of faith}

trait.name: Aura of Winter
entries: Allies within 10 ft. of Eva gain resistance to fire damage. Enemies that start their turn within 10 ft. of her must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have their speed reduced by 10 ft. until the start of their next turn.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit +3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Channel Divinity (1/Short Rest)
entries: Eva can use her Channel Divinity to either Turn Undead (as per cleric rules) or invoke a chilling blessing, causing up to 3 creatures of her choice within 30 ft. to regain 15 hit points.
